inboxes.description: List of mailing list inboxes to manage. Each inbox represents a unique mailing list.

name.description: Unique name for the list inbox (used as section key in config).

directory.description: Absolute path to the Git repository directory for this list's archive.

address.description: Primary email address associated with the list (e.g., list@example.com). Required for List-Id header.

owner.description: Email address of the list owner or maintainer (optional).

url.description: Public web URL for the list archive (e.g., https://example.com/archives/list). Auto-detected if omitted.

version.description: Public-Inbox version (1 or 2). Version 2 supports multiple epochs and is recommended.

feed.description: Enable Atom/JSON feed generation for this list.

feedmaxitems.description: Maximum number of recent items to include in the feed (used only if feed is enabled).

config.http.description: Configuration for the built-in HTTP daemon (public-inbox-httpd). Enable only if you want to serve archives via HTTP.

bind.description: IP address to bind the HTTP daemon to (e.g., 127.0.0.1 or 0.0.0.0).

port.description: Port for the HTTP daemon to listen on.

cert.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format).

key.description: Path to the SSL private key file (PEM format).

config.nntp.description: Configuration for the NNTP daemon (public-inbox-nntpd). Enable to allow NNTP access to archives.

enable.description: Whether to start the NNTP daemon.

bind.description: IP address to bind the NNTP daemon to.

port.description: Port for the NNTP daemon (standard NNTP: 119; NNTPS: 563).

config.script_alias.description: URL path prefix where public-inbox-httpd should be mounted (e.g., /public-inbox for https://example.com/public-inbox).
